ValidationRule.description: If Fin Category = Client Debit AND Fin Subcategory = Tax Debit Year Period & Tax_Jurisdiction are required fields
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Permission.Bypass_Credit_Debit_Request_Require_Year_Period_Tax_Jurisdiction ) , AND( ISPICKVAL( Fin_Category__c , "Client Debit" ) , ISPICKVAL( Fin_Subcategory__c , "Tax Debit" ) , OR( ISBLANK( TEXT( Year__c ) ) , ISBLANK( Period__c ) , ISBLANK( Tax_Jurisdiction__c ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Year, Period, and Tax Jurisdiction are required.
